header.contentDescription: A spinning gyroscope with the gravitational torque and the resulting precession drawn as perpendicular vectors

drawTextAnchored.text: and it turns sideways instead of falling
torque changes angular momentum, and angular momentum is a vector along the axle
faster spin means slower precession - a fast top stands up straighter for longer
Nothing here is mysterious; it is only that the response to a push is at right angles to it.
A wheel that will not fall
the push is down, the motion is sideways
